seller.name: Fieldwork Studio
seller.tagline: Design and engineering for the web

data.intro: Thank you for the conversations over the last few weeks. This quote sets out how we would rebuild your website platform, in up to three parts you can take together or on their own: a fixed-fee build, a monthly care retainer and a platform licence. Each has its own page with the line items behind its price.

lines.detail: Stakeholder interviews, analytics review and a written brief
Tokens, components and every page template, in two review rounds
Laravel and React build, content migration and go-live
WCAG 2.2 AA review and fixes before launch

models.name: Fixed-fee build
models.basis: One price for an agreed scope, invoiced at milestones
models.summary: We research, design and build the new platform to the scope agreed at discovery, then launch it with you. The price is fixed: changes to scope are quoted separately before any work starts.
models.note: Invoiced 30% at signature, 40% at design sign-off and 30% at launch.

models.name: Monthly care retainer
models.summary: A reserved block of design and engineering time every month, for improvements, new pages and anything the launch uncovers, with priority support for the site itself.
models.note: Unused hours roll over for one month. Invoiced monthly in advance.

models.name: Platform licence
models.basis: 120 editor seats for 12 months, priced by volume
models.summary: The editing platform your team works in, billed per editor seat per month. The seat price falls as the team grows; the break this quote uses is shown beside the line.

terms: This quote is valid for 30 days from the date of issue.
Prices are in US dollars. Sales tax is shown separately and charged where it applies.
Invoices are payable within 30 days. Late payments may pause scheduled work.
Scope changes are agreed in writing, with their price, before work on them starts.
You own the finished design and code on final payment; the platform licence is a subscription.
Either party may end the retainer or the licence with 30 days written notice.
